g.text: Timestamp convention: the correlation is most negative between -30 and +30

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Correlation of the hourly mean net power at the 8 MW Primaries with CAMS irradiance when the power stamps are shifted by the amount on the axis. Net power falls as irradiance rises, so the correlation is negative and the right shift makes it most negative. Top: clear-sky hours (clear-sky index above 0.8, clear-sky irradiance above 100 W/m²). Bottom: the plan's stricter test, with clear-sky irradiance above 400 W/m². The bottom panel is nearly flat. Thin lines: one site; thick line: the mean over sites.'
text.tspan: Correlation of the hourly mean net power at the 8 MW Primaries with CAMS irradiance when the
power stamps are shifted by the amount on the axis. Net power falls as irradiance rises, so the
correlation is negative and the right shift makes it most negative. Top: clear-sky hours
(clear-sky index above 0.8, clear-sky irradiance above 100 W/m²). Bottom: the plan's stricter
test, with clear-sky irradiance above 400 W/m². The bottom panel is nearly flat. Thin lines:
one site; thick line: the mean over sites.
